# EngineerOS

> AI-native workspace for engineers, researchers, and builders.

EngineerOS combines notes, tasks, projects, and daily entries into one connected system with semantic search, a knowledge graph, and an AI assistant with citations. All data lives in your own Supabase project — no vendor lock-in.

## What EngineerOS does

- Capture notes, tasks, and daily entries in one place
- Search everything with semantic (embedding-powered) search
- Visualize connections between notes and tasks as a knowledge graph
- Get AI-powered answers with citations back to exact source notes
- Automate recurring tasks and daily note creation
- Track reading, bookmarks, meetings, and code snippets in one system
- Integrate with GitHub for issues and repos

## Who it's for

Engineers, researchers, and builders who want a single second-brain workspace — without locking data in a proprietary cloud.

## Writing

Long-form articles. Each includes a short direct-answer summary at the top.

- https://engineeros-delta.vercel.app/blog — Index of all articles
- https://engineeros-delta.vercel.app/blog/rss.xml — RSS feed

### AGENTS.md, Cursor rules, and Claude skills are all solving the same problem — badly
https://engineeros-delta.vercel.app/blog/agents-md-cursor-rules-claude-skills
AGENTS.md, Cursor rules, and Claude skills solve three layers of one problem. AGENTS.md is portable plain markdown read by most agents. Cursor rules are Cursor-only and scope to file globs. Claude skills package an on-demand procedure. Rules and AGENTS.md are ambient adjectives; skills are invokable verbs. All three fail because they only carry what someone remembered to write down in advance.

### Your AI assistant is only as good as what it can retrieve
https://engineeros-delta.vercel.app/blog/semantic-search-over-your-own-notes
Semantic search finds notes by meaning, not exact words, by comparing embeddings with cosine similarity. Practical rules for a personal knowledge base: chunk on markdown headings rather than character counts, combine semantic and keyword search via reciprocal rank fusion, and always show citations so wrong answers are verifiable.

### Self-hosting your second brain, and why data ownership stopped being paranoid
https://engineeros-delta.vercel.app/blog/self-hosted-second-brain-supabase-pgvector
A self-hosted second brain keeps notes in a Postgres database you control, with pgvector for semantic search. You take on backups and upgrades and give up a full-time product team. You get SQL access to your own data, a real export path, and immunity to pricing or product changes you did not choose.

## Pricing summary

EngineerOS is free to start. See /pricing.md for structured tier details.
- Free: $0/month — unlimited notes, tasks, daily entries, semantic search, AI assistant
- Pro: contact for pricing — priority AI, advanced automation, custom themes
- Enterprise: custom — SSO, SLA, audit logs, dedicated support

## AI features

- Semantic search across all workspace content (embedding-based)
- AI assistant with source citations — answers grounded in your own notes
- Automatic knowledge graph from wikilinks and task links
- Automation rules: recurring tasks, keyword-based quick captures, daily rollover

## Technical details

- Built on Next.js (App Router) + Supabase (Postgres + pgvector)
- Self-hosted: your data stays in your own Supabase project
- Open-source core
- Robots.txt allows GPTBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, Bingbot
